svg.title: Florist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as florist, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A tied bouquet combines a rounded flower and a tulip with separate stems and a single open leaf. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a softly squared face.
